limitations: Known historical development questions with oracle supporting passages; no reserved final questions used. Repeated development comparisons are not an unbiased generalization estimate.
Assistant-authored source-grounded reviews, not independent human ground truth. Correct answers need not match reference formatting; ambiguous malformed questions are not silently repaired.

The same saved weights were reused; manifest comparison confirms verification_scope is the only configuration difference. Hashes identify reports/configurations and do not independently constitute a tensor-level weight audit.
The larger generator capability is inherited; its new workspace is untrained. This scope comparison does not establish learned workspace gains.
Question-free source entailment accepts an incorrect film comparison and a truncated biography that does not answer the question. NLI approval and lexical overlap are not answer correctness.
The magazine response attaches otherwise supported facts to the wrong named source.

Six source-withdrawal responses repeat the authored unavailability notice without formal abstention; two formally abstain. No factual original answer is retained in those eight controls, but completeness remains unscreened.
The single conflict is an authored fixture, not learned conflict resolution established across natural examples.
Memory hit rates concern 64 oracle support passages for these same 32 questions, not open-corpus retrieval or demonstrated answer gains from episodic memory.
No checkpoint promotion or release is supported by this diagnostic.
